CheckRainComment: If true, flint and steel will check for rain conditions before starting a fire.
CheckWindComment: If true, flint and steel will check for wind conditions before starting a fire.
ShowRedNotificationComment: Displays warning messages for failed attempts and reason.
EnableDebugLoggingComment: If true, debug logs will be enabled for FlintAndSteelHandler.
BreakChanceEnabledComment: If true, flint has a chance to break when used.
BreakChancePercentageComment: The percentage chance for flint to break on use (0 to 100).
